instructions_to_main_agent: Use .jsx extension for all React components (NOT .tsx).
Use 'Space Grotesk' for all headings to give a modern, tech-forward academic look.
For the Pricing Page, highlight the ₹51 (NEET) and ₹101 (JEE) plans with distinct color coding (Green vs Orange).
Ensure the Chat Interface is the central focus of the dashboard, similar to ChatGPT or Perplexity, but with student-friendly controls.
Use the 'Bento Grid' layout for the Student Dashboard to show 'Doubts Solved', 'Tests Taken', and 'Performance' in a visually interesting way.
Do NOT use generic gradients. Use solid colors or subtle noise textures.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.

do_not: Do not use teal (#1B93A4) for dashboards.
Do not center-align long text blocks.
must_do: Use 2-3x more spacing than standard (p-8, gap-8).
Use 'Shadcn' logic but customize the styles to match the 'E1' persona.
